papers.title: TRIAD: Benchmarking Omni-Modal Ambiguity in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Ambiguity is a central feature of natural communication: a sentence, image, or sound may remain underspecified until evidence from the other channels is considered. Yet current multimodal benchmarks mostly test perception, recognition, or reasoning over already determinate inputs, leaving unclear whether omni-modal large language models can resolve ambiguity distributed across text, vision, and audio. We introduce TRIAD, a benchmark for omni-modal ambiguity resolution. Each item is a text--image--audio triplet paired with a question and a set of answer options, and is constructed so that the full triplet determines a unique answer while removing any one modality makes the set of consistent options non-unique. TRIAD contains $327$ hand-written queries in $86$ scene groups and covers $18$ ambiguity categories across the three modalities. Evaluating $14$ omni-modal systems reveals that strong item-level performance does not translate into robust scene-level disambiguation: the best model still trails humans by over $20$ points in group accuracy. Removing answer options widens the gap further, driving model group accuracy to the single digits while humans remain robust. Leave-one-out and transcript/description counterfactuals further show that current systems often underuse audio cues when text and image are present. TRIAD reframes omni-modal evaluation around disambiguation rather than recognition, and provides a taxonomy, benchmark, and diagnostic protocol for measuring this capability.

summary.takeaway: 提出TRIAD基准，用文本-图像-音频三元组测试全模态大模型能否消解跨模态歧义，发现强项级表现不等于稳健的场景级消歧。
summary.methods: 构建327条人工编写查询、86个场景组、18类歧义的三元组数据，设计移除单一模态即答案不唯一的设置，评估14个全模态系统，并使用留一模态与转写/描述反事实诊断。
summary.relevance: 直接对应多模态学习与跨模态理解，为全模态模型的能力评测提供了以消歧为核心的新框架。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅给出最佳模型比人类低20余点的群体准确率差距，未说明具体模型、统计显著性或基准规模是否足以覆盖所有歧义类型。

papers.title: CellTrack-Bench: Microscopic Cell Tracking Benchmark for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Large language models have shown outstanding performance on text-first tasks such as coding, math, and writing. Recent efforts are shifting models' training to include scientific problems that often live in highly specialized domains beyond text, such as protein structure and biological images. However, in these scenarios, their general-purpose accuracy compared with specialized algorithms remains in question. One such domain is cell tracking, which requires spatiotemporal awareness of cell dynamics. To evaluate this, we created a new benchmark, CellTrack-Bench, which assesses Vision-Language Models' (VLMs) cell-tracking-related performance against specialized trackers. The full benchmark draws from 15 standard cell-tracking datasets across four imaging modalities and comprises 1,537 problems corresponding to 9,041 cell-linking decisions. We selected a hard subset requiring greater reasoning effort by identifying failures shared across distinct algorithmic trackers. With this proposed dataset, we: (i) evaluated different environment harnesses for VLMs; (ii) benchmarked 9 frontier closed-source models and 13 open-weight models; and (iii) provided a detailed analysis of their failure modes. Code, the stored model outputs, and a pipeline that regenerates the benchmark from the source datasets are available at https://github.com/royerlab/celltrack-bench.

summary.takeaway: 构建CellTrack-Bench，比较视觉语言模型与专用细胞追踪算法在细胞链接决策上的表现，并分析其失败模式。
summary.methods: 从15个标准细胞追踪数据集、4种成像模态中构建1537个问题、9041个细胞链接决策，并筛选出多种算法追踪器共同失败的困难子集，评测9个闭源与13个开放权重模型。
summary.relevance: 契合多模态学习与跨模态理解，将大模型评测扩展到生物医学图像中的时空推理任务。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告VLMs与专用追踪器的具体性能差距数值，也未说明困难子集的筛选是否引入选择偏差。

papers.title: A Visual Grounding Benchmark for Retinal OCT with Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can answer clinical questions about medical images, but trustworthy use requires visual grounding: models should localize the pathology they report rather than rely on spurious shortcuts. Whether MLLMs can visually ground clinical findings in retinal optical coherence tomography (OCT), the most widely used imaging modality in ophthalmology, remains largely unexplored. To address this gap, we introduce RetinaGroundBench, the first benchmark for biomarker visual grounding in retinal OCT. It comprises 815 B-scans exhaustively annotated by ophthalmologists with 4,537 bounding boxes covering 13 biomarkers across 8 diseases. Because MLLMs often fragment a single lesion into multiple partial predictions, we propose AggIoU, a metric that evaluates whether the union of overlapping predicted boxes covers the annotated region. Across 27 open-source MLLMs (0.8-38B parameters), we find that visual grounding remains largely unsolved: the best general-purpose model achieves a macro F1 of just 23.7%, with consistently low recall, despite reaching up to 73% balanced accuracy on biomarker presence questions. To narrow this gap, we developed RetGrounder, an MLLM fine-tuned using an OCT-specific strategy integrating grounding and textual information. Despite its relatively small size (8B), RetGrounder improves grounding F1 to 33.9%, a 43% relative improvement. Our benchmark provides a reference point for measuring progress in the field of OCT diagnosis with MLLMs.

summary.takeaway: 提出RetinaGroundBench，首个面向视网膜OCT生物标志物视觉定位的基准，并发现现有MLLMs的定位能力仍远未解决。
summary.methods: 由眼科医生对815张B扫描做穷尽标注，含13种生物标志物、8种疾病的4537个边界框；提出AggIoU指标，评测27个开源MLLM，并微调出8B的RetGrounder。
summary.relevance: 关联多模态学习与大语言模型在医学图像中的可信应用，强调报告发现需有视觉定位支撑。
summary.caveat: 摘要显示最佳通用模型宏F1仅23.7%、RetGrounder提升至33.9%，绝对性能仍低；基准局限于OCT单一模态，结论不宜外推到其他影像。

papers.title: ReflectPO: Reflection-Guided Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.abstract: With external tools, large language models (LLMs) can tackle complex tasks through sustained environmental interaction. LLM-based agents are therefore increasingly used to tackle complex long-horizon tasks in real-world environments. However, these tasks involve sequential, interdependent decisions and changes in environmental states. Early execution errors affect subsequent interaction histories and environmental states, and their effects accumulate along the decision chain. To address this challenge, we propose Reflection-Guided Policy Optimization (ReflectPO), a reinforcement learning framework for autonomous error recovery in long-horizon tasks. ReflectPO comprises two core components. The first is Reflection-Guided Sampling. We use branch differences and repeated visits in interaction trajectories to construct hints for error recovery. The second is Tree-Structured Credit Assignment. We organize sampled trajectories into trees and assign action-level credit using parent--child reward differences and recovery gains. Experiments over two long-horizon tool-use benchmarks show that ReflectPO outperforms multiple existing baselines in most domains. It also achieves the best overall performance on average. Further analyses show that ReflectPO effectively improves agents' ability to recognize their own deviations, recover from erroneous states, and continue making progress toward task completion.

summary.takeaway: 提出ReflectPO强化学习框架，利用反思引导采样与树状信用分配提升长程LLM智能体的错误恢复能力。
summary.methods: 从交互轨迹的分支差异与重复访问构造纠错提示，将采样轨迹组织为树并用父子奖励差与恢复增益做动作级信用分配，在两个长程工具使用基准上对比多个基线。
summary.relevance: 对应大语言模型智能体与强化学习，关注长程决策链中的误差累积与自我纠正。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅称在多数领域优于基线并取得最佳平均表现，未给出具体提升幅度、基准名称或消融实验细节。

papers.title: When News Gets Old: Portfolio Allocation with Reinforcement Learning and Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Financial news can influence investment decisions long after publication. Timely news may reach an investor before prices fully adjust, whereas older news may already be reflected in prices. We examine two ways to handle aging signals: retain them and give a portfolio policy timing information, or filter them out before portfolio selection. A fixed large language model (LLM) extracts signals from public SEC disclosures. We compare these treatments in reinforcement learning (RL) policies and LLMs that choose portfolios directly. We evaluate returns after trading costs in historical tests over 2023-2025. RL choices respond to timing information in a controlled test, but historical returns show no consistent benefit from adding it. For the LLM, filtering old news produced the highest average net return, reaching 18.43% per year when news delivery was delayed by four weeks. This exceeded the returns of all RL strategies that used news.

summary.takeaway: 比较保留或过滤老龄新闻信号对投资组合策略的影响，发现RL策略虽能响应时间信息但历史收益无一致增益，而LLM直接选组合时过滤旧新闻平均净收益最高。
summary.methods: 用固定LLM从公开SEC披露中提取信号，在RL策略与直接选组合的LLM两种设定下比较处理方式，基于2023–2025年历史数据评估扣费后收益。
summary.relevance: 涉及大语言模型、强化学习与检索增强式信号利用，讨论新闻时效性在决策中的价值。
summary.caveat: 结果为特定历史区间与单一信号提取流程下的回测，摘要未说明交易成本建模细节、样本外稳健性或统计显著性，不宜视为因果结论。

papers.title: MoG-VLM: Efficient Video Anomaly Detection through Motion-Guided Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong potential for video anomaly detection, but dense frame-level inference makes them impractical for real-time deployment. Existing acceleration commonly relies on uniform sampling, which ignores content dynamics and can either waste computation on static segments or miss localized anomalies. We propose MoG-VLM a motion-adaptive anomaly detection framework that leverages motion purely as a lightweight control signal to decide when VLM inference is necessary. To this end, we introduce Temporal Gradient Magnitude (TGM) which performs content-aware sampling to concentrate computation on informative regions while avoiding redundant processing. We further introduce a hierarchical dual-stream design in which dense multi-frame VLM reasoning is activated only around frames with elevated anomaly likelihood, via anchor-triggered context-window expansion with early termination. A fusion module then reconciles these instantaneous semantic cues with temporal action dynamics. Across four benchmarks, our method achieves 91.91%, 84.30%, 87.88%, and 78.96% AUC-ROC on XD-Violence, UCF-Crime, MSAD, and ShanghaiTech, respectively, establishing new state of the art on three benchmarks under the zero-shot, training-free setting. On XD-Violence, we improve over the previous best result by +0.57% while delivering a 1.31x inference speedup. These results demonstrate that content-aware allocation of VLM capacity, processing fewer frames more intelligently rather than all frames uniformly, is a more effective axis of progress than uniformly densifying VLM inference across frames. Code is available on GitHub: https://github.com/kdawoud91/MoG-VLM.

summary.takeaway: 提出MoG-VLM，以运动作为轻量控制信号自适应决定何时调用VLM推理，在零样本免训练设定下提升视频异常检测效率与部分基准性能。
summary.methods: 引入时序梯度幅值做内容感知采样，采用层次双流设计在异常可能性高的帧附近触发密集多帧VLM推理并早停，再用融合模块结合语义线索与时序动作动态。
summary.relevance: 关联多模态学习与跨模态理解，展示VLM在视频异常检测中的高效部署路径。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告在XD-Violence上较此前最佳提升0.57%并加速1.31倍，但三个基准的新SOTA表述与零样本免训练设定需结合完整实验确认，且其他基准提升幅度未给出。

papers.title: Data-Driven Vision-Language Models for Remote Sensing: A Survey
papers.abstract: During the deep learning era, innovations in remote sensing (RS) vision models primarily focused on optimizing network architectures for specific tasks and conducting end-to-end training. However, with the advent of the Vision-Language Models (VLMs) era, constrained by substantial computational resource demands, the mainstream research paradigm has shifted towards adapting general-purpose VLMs using RS vertical domain data for fine-tuning, rather than modifying their core architectures. This transition marks a change in the innovation pathway from model-centric to data-centric. Despite the increasing importance of data, the academic community still lacks a systematic, data-centric survey to guide researchers in constructing high-quality RS vision-language datasets for various application scenarios and in conducting effective model fine-tuning and performance evaluation based on these datasets. To address this gap, this paper presents a systematic review of the development status of RS datasets tailored for VLMs. It further provides a comprehensive practical guide for RS researchers in the large model era, covering the entire pipeline from data construction to fine-tuning and evaluation. This paper aims to encourage the academic community to build more diverse and higher-quality vision-language datasets for specialized RS sub-fields. Ultimately, the goal is to converge these efforts into a comprehensive RS vision-language corpus that offers extensive task coverage and a wide geographical distribution, thereby laying a solid data foundation for advancing towards general artificial intelligence in RS.

summary.takeaway: 系统综述遥感领域面向视觉语言模型的数据集发展，主张研究范式从模型中心转向数据中心，并提供从数据构建到微调评估的实践指南。
summary.methods: 综述遥感视觉语言数据集的构建现状，梳理数据构建、模型微调与性能评估的完整流程，并提出构建更广覆盖遥感语料的方向。
summary.relevance: 对应多模态学习与跨模态理解，为遥感专用VLM的数据与评测提供参考框架。
summary.caveat: 作为综述，摘要未给出具体数据集数量、覆盖统计或对现有方法性能的系统性定量比较。

papers.title: Federated Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract: Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) leverages centralized knowledge graphs to enhance large language models with structured knowledge retrieval. However, real-world knowledge is inherently distributed across multiple organizations rather than being centrally accessible. Privacy constraints further prohibit sharing entire local knowledge graphs, preventing GraphRAG from effectively retrieving and utilizing distributed knowledge. To this end, we propose Federated GraphRAG (FedGRAG), a unified framework for distributed graph retrieval and knowledge-enhanced generation over multiple clients with knowledge graphs. Specifically, we address two fundamental challenges in federated GraphRAG. First, the absence of a global knowledge graph makes unified retrieval impossible. To address this, we develop a Federated Knowledge Routing mechanism that efficiently identifies relevant clients through lightweight knowledge indices without exposing local graph structures. Second, local graph memory cannot be shared directly because it contains sensitive entities and knowledge information. We therefore propose a controlled-disclosure evidence construction method. It extracts retrieved evidence subgraphs and converts them into an evidence abstract, enabling evidence conversion and reconstruction on the server. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Federated GraphRAG consistently outperforms existing baselines in both retrieval and downstream generation tasks, establishing a new paradigm for deploying GraphRAG in federated environments.

summary.takeaway: 提出FedGRAG，在多个客户端各自持有知识图谱且不共享图结构的约束下，实现联邦图检索与知识增强生成。
summary.methods: 设计联邦知识路由机制，用轻量知识索引识别相关客户端而不暴露本地图结构；提出受控披露的证据构建方法，将检索到的证据子图转为证据摘要以便服务器端转换与重构。
summary.relevance: 直接对应检索增强与知识图谱主题，将GraphRAG扩展到隐私受限的分布式环境。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅称在检索与下游生成任务上持续优于现有基线，未给出数据集、隐私保证形式或通信开销的具体量化结果。

papers.title: An Empirical Study of Recent Large Language Models for Knowledge Graph to Text Generation on Standard Benchmarks
papers.abstract: Knowledge graph-to-text (KG-to-text) generation verbalizes a set of knowledge graph triples into fluent natural language. While fine-tuned encoder-decoder models have long been the standard approach, recent LLMs are becoming increasingly competitive. We benchmark recent LLMs against fine-tuned encoder-decoder models, using reference-based metrics and graph-grounded reference-free LLM-based evaluation validated against human annotations. We observed that recent LLMs substantially narrow, and in several settings close, the gap with fine-tuned models on reference-based metrics, while performing better on graph-grounded metrics. LLM-based evaluation scores show limited correlation with reference-based metrics, suggesting that the two approaches capture different aspects of generation quality. Graph-grounded evaluation reveals that prompted models produce fewer contradictions and triple omissions than fine-tuned models, and these errors increase more rapidly with graph size for fine-tuned models, highlighting differences between the two approaches that reference-based metrics may not fully capture.

summary.takeaway: 系统比较近期LLM与微调encoder-decoder模型在KG-to-text任务上的表现，发现LLM在参考指标上差距缩小，而在图接地指标上更优，且两类评测相关性有限。
summary.methods: 在标准基准上对比近期LLM与微调encoder-decoder模型，采用参考指标和经人工标注验证的图接地无参考LLM评测。
summary.relevance: 直接关联大语言模型与知识图谱主题，考察LLM用于知识图谱到文本生成的能力边界。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体模型、数据集名称和数值结果，结论基于所测设置，泛化性需进一步验证。

papers.title: METTA: Memory-Enhanced Test-Time Adaptation for Meta-Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Meta-reinforcement learning aims to train agents that adapt quickly to unseen tasks from limited interaction, but this requires representing task evidence over long interaction histories. Classical recurrent agents compress experience into hidden states, while transformer-based agents retrieve from past trajectories at quadratic memory and computation cost. In this work, we propose Memory-Enhanced Test-Time Adaptation (METTA) for meta-reinforcement learning. It decomposes the fast adaptation phase into two temporal scales: a causal neural memory performs fine-grained within-episode adaptation with linear sequence complexity, while compact episode-level summaries support long-range cross-episode task inference without attending over the full interaction history. Moreover, equipping agents with neural memory provides sufficient expressive capacity and test-time training capability, enabling effective adaptation to unseen held-out tasks and task families at meta-test time. On unseen held-out Meta-World ML10/45 test environments, METTA achieves a success rate over $50\%$ while maintaining a low training budget and short wall-clock time. On long-context sparse-reward PointMaze tasks, it outperforms transformer-based baselines by exhibiting more structured exploration behavior. These results show that METTA provides an efficient path toward more adaptive and scalable long-context meta-RL.

summary.takeaway: 提出METTA，将元强化学习的快速适应分解为因果神经记忆的回合内细粒度适应与回合级摘要的跨回合任务推断，兼顾长上下文效率与适应性。
summary.methods: 使用线性复杂度的因果神经记忆和紧凑回合级摘要，并在Meta-World ML10/45和PointMaze任务上评估。
summary.relevance: 关联强化学习与持续适应主题，针对元强化学习中的长历史表示与测试时适应问题。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告部分成功率与环境表现，未详述基线范围、消融完整性和跨任务族泛化细节。

papers.title: Loop to Look Better: Learning Adaptive Depth for Question-Guided Perception in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Visual perception should be iterative and task-directed, with representations refined in response to the question and the need for further processing. While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) increasingly support extended reasoning, their visual tokens are still typically acquired in a single, task-agnostic encoder pass. This creates an evidence-acquisition bottleneck: models may reason longer without refining the visual evidence needed to answer the question. We propose LoopLook, a lightweight encoder-side recurrent perception framework that equips pretrained VLMs with adaptive visual depth. LoopLook recurrently revisits a middle-to-late window of the vision encoder, injecting question representations at each loop to guide visual refinement. A learned stopping mechanism adaptively determines the recurrent depth, while a token-wise Mixture-of-Looks (MoL) combines representations from different loops, allowing each visual token to selectively integrate information acquired across recurrent steps. Across four backbones and eight benchmarks, LoopLook consistently improves performance over the baseline, yielding gains of up to 8.6% on MMStar and 8.1% on HallusionBench. Our analysis shows that LoopLook progressively refines visual attention and adaptively allocates depth according to task difficulty. It also better preserves task-relevant visual information under reduced input resolution, while increasing time to first token (TTFT) by only 5.1-6.5%. By bringing recurrence from reasoning back into perception, LoopLook transforms visual perception from a one-shot glimpse into an adaptive process of recurrent refinement.

summary.takeaway: 提出LoopLook，在视觉编码器中引入问题引导的循环感知与自适应深度，使视觉表征随问题迭代细化。
summary.methods: 在预训练VLM的视觉编码器中循环回访中后层窗口，注入问题表示，使用学习停止机制和token级Mixture-of-Looks，在四个骨干和八个基准上评测。
summary.relevance: 关联多模态学习与跨模态理解，针对VLM视觉证据获取瓶颈与推理深度不匹配问题。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告最高8.6%和8.1%的基准提升，但具体骨干、基准构成及与更大规模模型的对比细节有限。

papers.title: VLTest: Finding Joint Image-Text Failures in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly embedded in software systems. Testing them raises two problems. Mutating either input can change the expected answer, so an output change is not by itself a failure. Some failures appear only when both inputs are mutated; attributing them to the combination requires testing each mutation alone. We present VLTest, a black-box VLM testing approach. It generates image variants by editing VQGAN latent codes and text variants with a rewrite-expand-prune pipeline, filters variants likely to change the expected answer, and tests each variant alone before testing combinations, so every joint failure has four matched cells. A VLM judge confirms a failure only after checking that the input keeps the expected answer. On three tasks with eight VLMs, including two commercial API models, the oracle confirms 81.7% of the candidates, with 88.8% to 94.6% precision against human labels, and four-cell confirmation rejects 22.5% of joint candidates. Under the same budget, VLTest's generators find 1.8 to 2.5 times as many confirmed failures as SINVAD and TextFooler, and its joint tests find 91 to 197 attributed joint failures per 1,000 joint calls, 1.3 times as many as the same pairing applied to the baselines' variants.

summary.takeaway: 提出VLTest黑盒测试方法，通过四格对照设计识别仅在图像与文本联合变异时出现的VLM联合失败。
summary.methods: 用VQGAN潜码编辑生成图像变体、rewrite-expand-prune生成文本变体，过滤可能改变期望答案的变体，先单独测试再组合测试，并用VLM judge确认失败。
summary.relevance: 关联多模态学习与跨模态理解，关注VLM在图文联合输入下的可靠性与测试问题。
summary.caveat: 摘要给出81.7% oracle确认率及88.8%–94.6%精确率，但任务、模型与人类标注规模未详述，结论可能受测试集选择影响。

papers.title: RECAP: Looking Once Is Not Enough for Vision-Language Reasoning
papers.abstract: Long chain-of-thought reasoning improves vision-language models (VLMs), but it also exposes a temporal grounding failure: as generation unfolds, models may drift from image evidence while reinforcement learning still provides only a final-answer reward. We study this gap through visual revisit, a temporally localized reactivation of image evidence during reasoning. Across three VLM backbones, revisit peaks are predictive of correctness and causally linked to performance: masking them degrades accuracy more than masking non-peaks, while injecting revisit-like peaks into failed rollouts partially restores correct answers. Control analyses show that this signal is not explained by raw attention strength, uncertainty, logit margin, or hidden-state norm. We propose RECAP, a GRPO-compatible training method that turns detached revisit traces into a credit-assignment signal. RECAP uses revisit-conditioned advantage estimation, dynamic discounting, and gated value prediction to propagate final rewards through visually important reasoning steps, without extra rewards, additional rollouts, or inference-time changes. Across Qwen2.5-VL-7B, InternVL3-8B, and LLaVA-OV-7B, RECAP consistently improves over GRPO and VPPO, yielding $+6.1$--$+6.5$ HallusionBench gains over the SFT base while preserving reasoning and text-only performance. Results on larger LoRA-tuned models, Chinese zero-shot benchmarks, visual perturbations, and human evaluation further demonstrate robust improvements in image-grounded reasoning.

summary.takeaway: 识别VLM长链推理中的时间接地失败，提出RECAP利用视觉回访轨迹作为信用分配信号，提升图像接地推理。
summary.methods: 基于GRPO兼容训练，采用回访条件优势估计、动态折扣和门控价值预测，在Qwen2.5-VL-7B、InternVL3-8B和LLaVA-OV-7B上评估。
summary.relevance: 同时关联强化学习、多模态学习与跨模态理解，针对RL仅用最终答案奖励导致的视觉证据漂移。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告HallusionBench相对SFT基座提升6.1–6.5，但未提供全部基准数值、训练成本及失败案例分析。

papers.title: scHGNN: A single-cell gene regulatory network inference method based on heuristic graph neural networks.
papers.abstract: The construction of gene regulatory networks based on single-cell transcriptomics (scRNA-seq) data provides crucial technical support for decoding cell fate determination mechanisms at the single-cell level, elucidating molecular mechanisms underlying disease progression, and developing targeted therapeutics. Existing methods for constructing GRNs often rely excessively on gene expression features, struggling to achieve an effective balance between local direct regulatory signals and global multi-step regulatory pathways. This imbalance results in insufficient utilization of topological information within the network structure. Therefore, this study proposes a heuristic graph neural network-based GRN inference model (scHGNN). scHGNN integrates multi-order neighbor topological information into learnable weights through unified heuristic matrix and link prediction modules, thereby balancing local and global regulatory relationships. This approach effectively fuses gene expression features with network structural information to achieve precise inference of latent regulatory links within gene regulatory networks. Across GRN inference tasks using benchmark networks of varying gene scales and diverse origins, scHGNN consistently outperforms existing mainstream methods on key evaluation metrics. Furthermore, in target gene prediction cases for key transcription factors such as TP53, OTX2, and FOXP1, the model achieved validation rates as high as 76%-84% in the hTFtarget database. This not only supports its accuracy in identifying known regulatory relationships but also indicates its potential to identify high-confidence candidate regulatory interactions for further biological investigation. Collectively, these results demonstrate that scHGNN holds significant application value in elucidating gene regulatory mechanisms and exploring the molecular basis of related diseases.

summary.takeaway: 提出scHGNN，将多阶邻居拓扑信息融入可学习权重，平衡局部直接调控与全局多步调控关系以推断单细胞基因调控网络。
summary.methods: 基于启发式矩阵和链接预测模块的图神经网络，融合基因表达特征与网络结构信息，在不同规模基准网络及TP53、OTX2、FOXP1靶基因预测案例中评估。
summary.relevance: 直接关联GRN/Regulon与图谱构建表示主题，面向单细胞转录组数据的调控网络推断。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告hTFtarget数据库验证率76%–84%，但未说明与主流方法对比的具体指标、数据来源及假阳性控制情况。

papers.title: Gandalf: Flash Shall Not Die! Increasing Flash Storage Lifetime for KV Cache Offloading in LLM Serving
papers.abstract: KV caching reduces the serving cost of large language models (LLMs), but the growing KV cache footprint is increasingly exceeds GPU and host-memory capacity. Therefore, people use SSD to expand the KV cache storage capacity with high I/O bandwidth. However, in production LLM workload, such as multi-round conversation and LLM agents, the total amount of KV cache writes significantly exceeds SSD capacity, shortening SSD lifetime from years to months. To improve SSD lifetime, a natural solution is to reduce the KV cache writes by gating the KV cache writes via historical access patterns. However, that significantly lowers the KV cache hit rate (and increase the LLM serving cost) since KV caches from different attention types might have identical historical access pattern but different future access patterns. Our insight is that, to reduce KV cache writes without hurting KV cache hit rate, one need to not only consider the access pattern, but also application-level information such as the attention type of KV cache. Leveraging this observation, we propose Gandalf , the first SSD KV cache offloading system with SSD life time awareness. Gandalf prioritize the admission of full-attention KV cache into SSD over the cache generated by other types of attention, which significantly increases SSD lifetime without sacrificing cache hit rate. Our evaluation shows that Gandalf extends the SSD lifetime by 7.3X on average, while having negligible impact on cache hit rate across multiple workload traces and wide range of hardware capacity. Gandalf design can be extended to other flash-based storage, such as High Bandwidth Flash (HBF).

summary.takeaway: 提出Gandalf，利用注意力类型等应用层信息优先将full-attention KV cache写入SSD，在几乎不损失命中率的前提下延长闪存寿命。
summary.methods: 面向LLM服务的SSD KV cache卸载系统，按注意力类型进行准入控制，并在多种工作负载和硬件容量下评估。
summary.relevance: 关联大语言模型与检索增强/服务效率主题，针对KV cache卸载中的SSD寿命问题。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告平均延长SSD寿命7.3倍，但工作负载轨迹、硬件配置和命中率具体数值未详述，实际生产适用性仍需验证。

papers.title: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of Large Language Models to a Low-Resource Agglutinative Language: A Corpus, Datasets, and a Reproducible Benchmark for the Bashkir Language
papers.abstract: Bashkir is a low-resource agglutinative language written in Cyrillic and remains poorly represented in modern LLMs. We present an open resource suite and a systematic benchmark of adaptation methods: the Bashkir Web Corpus (71,567 documents, 46.9M tokens, 16 sources) and three labelled datasets for binary, multiclass and multilabel text classification; the benchmark covers the first two. Experiments use eight architectures (82M-8B: DistilGPT2, GPT-2 base/medium, Phi-3-mini, Mistral-7B, YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B, mBERT, XLM-R) and three adaptation groups (full fine-tuning, QLoRA, in-context learning), plus continual pretraining (CPT). (1) QLoRA on 3.8-8B models outperforms encoder-only fine-tuning on binary classification: YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B with CPT reaches macro-F1 0.748 vs 0.653 (XLM-R) and 0.650 (mBERT); pairwise differences are significant after Holm correction (p<0.001). (2) YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B significantly outperforms Mistral-7B and Phi-3-mini on multiclass classification, BPB and native-speaker ratings (mean 3.28 vs 2.52 and 2.22; n=100; alpha=0.69-0.77; p<0.05); on binary classification its QLoRA advantage is not significant (p>=0.084). (3) CPT effects depend on model and task: perplexity improves for Phi-3-mini (+0.58) and YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B (+0.33) but worsens for Mistral-7B (-1.15, p<0.001); on binary classification CPT helps Mistral-7B most (+4.0 macro-F1). (4) Tokeniser fertility on Bashkir varies 2.67x (2.92-7.80) and tracks adaptation quality, while perplexity across tokenisers is not comparable. Cyrillic tokenisers with Russian pretraining are preferable; LLM judges reproduce native ratings for grammar and coherence (rho=0.33-0.46) but not language correctness (rho=0.16, p=0.11); native evaluation remains necessary. All artefacts are open-licensed.

summary.takeaway: 为低资源黏着语巴什基尔语构建开放语料、标注数据集与可复现基准，系统比较多种LLM适配方法。
summary.methods: 发布Bashkir Web Corpus及三个文本分类数据集，在八种架构和全微调、QLoRA、上下文学习及持续预训练设置下评测。
summary.relevance: 关联大语言模型、持续适应与预训练主题，提供低资源语言参数高效适配的实证基准。
summary.caveat: 结论限于巴什基尔语和所测任务，二元分类中部分QLoRA优势不显著，且LLM评判在语言正确性上与母语者评分相关性低。

papers.title: PointerBench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Fine-Grained GUI Grounding
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models have shown promising performance in computer-use tasks, from planning user workflows to grounding natural-language actions to precise UI targets. Existing end-to-end benchmarks primarily emphasize long-horizon task completion, while GUI grounding benchmarks remain focused on conventional controls and a limited set of professional interfaces. We introduce POINTERBENCH, a diagnostic suite of 1,500 screenshot-instruction pairs probing three complementary capabilities: thin sub-element identification and geometric grounding in spreadsheets (POINTERBENCH-Sheets), character-level grounding in long-text documents (POINTERBENCH-Text), and mixed GUI grounding across 100 professional applications (POINTERBENCH-Pro). We carefully curate each task with pixel-exact target geometry and evaluate both general-purpose multimodal models and 39 specialist GUI grounding configurations. We find text grounding to be the most challenging setting, with Claude Fable 5, GPT-5.6 Sol, and the leading native specialist UI-Venus-2-9B achieving 69.6%, 53.4%, and 25.8% success on POINTERBENCH-Text despite respective 83.2%, 77.7%, and 54.5% average success across POINTERBENCH. These results reveal substantial headroom in fine-grained GUI grounding across frontier and specialist models. We publicly release the benchmark and evaluation code at https://github.com/warmwindOS/pointerbench.

summary.takeaway: 提出 POINTERBENCH 诊断基准，用 1500 组截图-指令对细粒度评测多模态模型的 GUI grounding 能力，覆盖电子表格、长文档与专业应用三类场景。
summary.methods: 构建三个子集：Sheets（电子表格子元素识别与几何定位）、Text（长文档字符级定位）、Pro（100 个专业应用的混合 GUI 定位）；每个任务提供像素级精确目标几何，评测通用多模态模型与 39 种 GUI grounding 专用配置。
summary.relevance: 直接关联多模态学习与 LLM 计算机使用任务，为 GUI 定位能力的细粒度诊断提供评测工具。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明数据采集与标注质量控制细节及评测统计显著性；结论仅基于摘要中报告的通过率，不代表对其他场景的泛化。

papers.title: Zero-Shot Domain Generalization via Domain Prompt Learning
papers.abstract: Domain generalization (DG) aims to improve the generalization of the model to any unseen domains. Targeting this goal, existing DG methods mainly focus on learning domain-invariant features or prompts from the given source domains. However, these methods rely on source-domain data, and collecting and annotating large-scale single- or multi-source datasets is often infeasible, limiting the practical applicability of DG. To tackle this challenge, we propose {\underline{Do}}main \underline{P}rompt Learning (DoP), a method built on a large vision-language model (e.g., CLIP) for zero-shot domain generalization, which recognizes unseen classes in unseen target domains without access to source-domain data. DoP essentially learns the target domain knowledge via prompt both in text and visual modalities to overcome the domain shift in text-visual modalities under the test-time adaptation formulation. Specifically, DoP first takes text domain learning (TDL) to simulate various distribution shifts by learning diverse style tokens implicitly in the text space with inter-style diversity loss and intra-style consistency loss. Subsequently, DoP employs visual domain learning (VDL) to further refine the target-domain-relevant style token generated by TDL by making use of the test visual data with self-supervised learning. Extensive experiments on popular DG benchmark datasets (e.g., PACS, VLCS, OfficeHome, and DomainNet) and ImageNet show that our DoP consistently outperforms the state-of-the-art DG approaches. Codes are available at: https://github.com/shiming-chen/DoP.

summary.takeaway: 提出 DoP，在无法访问源域数据的情况下，利用 CLIP 类视觉-语言模型通过文本与视觉双模态提示学习实现零样本域泛化。
summary.methods: 文本域学习以风格 token 和样式间多样性/样式内一致性损失模拟分布偏移，视觉域学习用测试图像自监督精炼风格 token；在 PACS、VLCS、OfficeHome、DomainNet 与 ImageNet 上实验。
summary.relevance: 关联持续适应与预训练、多模态学习及跨模态理解，探讨无源数据的测试时适应与提示学习。
summary.caveat: 摘要给出“持续优于 SOTA”的定性表述但未列具体数值；方法依赖 CLIP 类模型能力，对非视觉域或极强域偏移的适用性未在摘要中说明。

papers.title: Automated Enrichment Analysis with GraphRAG: Efficient Multi-Database ORA Extraction and Biological Interpretation
papers.abstract: Over-representation analysis (ORA) is widely used to interpret gene-expression studies, but its outputs are often fragmented across gene-set databases and presented as flat term lists that obscure gene-level links among related enrichment signals. We propose Graph-Based Over-Representation Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GBOR-RAG), an integrated and traceable framework for ORA interpretation. GBOR-RAG represents heterogeneous gene-set databases as a unified term--gene knowledge graph, where shared genes connect related terms across sources. After graph-based ORA scoring, the framework retrieves a compact connected evidence subgraph that preserves both cross-database relationships and gene-level support. The subgraph conditions an LLM to generate biological interpretations, and we introduce a claim-level faithfulness metric to assess whether generated claims are supported by explicit evidence. Experiments show that graph-based ORA preserves conventional ORA results with high consistency (mean Pearson $r=0.997$) while reducing query time by a median of $37\times$ (up to $48\times$). The retrieved subgraphs average 36.8 nodes and achieve the highest overall integration score (4.12), and GBOR-RAG attains the highest claim-level faithfulness (0.90) among the compared systems. Adding a PubMed literature layer further improves the overall interpretation quality from 4.17 to 4.75.

summary.takeaway: 这项研究聚焦于检索增强与对齐、知识图谱。原文摘要要点：Over-representation analysis (ORA) is widely used to interpret gene-expression studies, but its outputs are often fragmented across gene-set databases and presented as flat term lists that obscure gene-level links among related enrichment signals. We propose Graph-Based Over-Representation Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GBOR-RAG), an integrated and traceab…
summary.methods: 检索增强生成、知识图谱
summary.relevance: 命中当前论文雷达的主题：检索增强与对齐、知识图谱。
summary.caveat: 当前为无 API Key 的自动提取结果；关键结论、实验规模和局限请以原文为准。

papers.title: Ask About the Right Moment: Training-Free Object Identity Reasoning for Video-Language Models
papers.abstract: Many questions about a video concern one physical object. Where does the ball end up after the cups are shuffled? Which card is the queen? How often was the mug covered? Video-language models (Video-LMs) recognise such objects in single frames but do not keep them apart over time. On real shell-game videos, open models from 8B to 235B parameters, their thinking variants, a reinforcement-learned tool agent and three training-free tool agents all stay within ten points of chance. We separate semantic identity binding from temporal identity maintenance. An object's identity should be fixed at a moment when the evidence for it is visible, and carried afterwards by a tracker. \emph{Track, Then Bind} implements this principle without training. A promptable video tracker follows every candidate object and draws it with a track number. A frozen vision-language model answers a static question about the identifying evidence, which binds the target to a track. The answer is then derived from the tracked state in text, without asking the model to reinterpret the original video during read-out. A single configuration covers all benchmarks. With Qwen3-VL-32B it solves both VET-Bench tasks, where a fine-tuned trajectory model reaches 92\% and 90\% and the same VLM voting over 16 samples stays at 30--32\%. It answers 55.4\% of the hardest Perception Test cup games, where the best published model answers 41.5\%, and, using track-derived timelines, 48.6\% of TOC-Bench questions, against 37.1\% for the same model answering directly. Drawing the same tracks on the video and asking the question directly falls 12--19 points short of the agent on real cup games.

summary.takeaway: 提出免训练的 Track, Then Bind 框架，将语义身份绑定与时间身份维持分离，显著提升视频-语言模型在杯子游戏等物体身份追踪问题上的表现。
summary.methods: 用可提示视频追踪器为候选物体画轨编号，冻结视觉-语言模型回答静态识别问题以将目标绑定到轨迹，再从追踪状态推导答案；在 VET-Bench、Perception Test 杯子游戏与 TOC-Bench 上评测。
summary.relevance: 关联多模态学习与跨模态视频理解，针对 Video-LM 在时间维度上维持物体身份的短板。
summary.caveat: 比较数字来自摘要自述，未提供跨模型与跨数据集的完整消融；依赖外部追踪器质量，追踪失败时的误差传播未在摘要中讨论。

papers.title: Robust Identification of Drug Mechanism of Action Associated Genes Across Heterogeneous Drug Treated Datasets
papers.abstract: Identifying genes associated with the mechanism of action (MOA) of anticancer therapies is essential for understanding drug response. Functional genomics approaches, including genome-wide CRISPR knock out screens, enable systematic gene prioritization following treatment; however, findings from individual datasets are typically interpreted after identifying overlapping genes across datasets to confirm biological hypotheses. Integrating such heterogeneous datasets remains challenging due to variability across experimental conditions. Existing approaches can miss biologically relevant genes due to dataset-specific noise, can fail to capture genes exhibiting consistent but moderate effects across studies. Here, we present ConcuRx, a statistical framework for cross-study integration and gene prioritization across heterogeneous CRISPR drug-response screens. This approach produces more stable gene rankings than single-dataset analyses, improving prioritization of known MOA-associated genes and recovering biologically relevant genes that are overlooked by average- and overlap-based approaches. Applied to CRISPR drug-response screens for the synergistic drug pair of ATR and PARP inhibitors, ConcuRx strengthened support for 15 experimentally validated hypotheses collected from published studies, including mechanisms supported by independent studies not included in the ConcuRx analysis. These findings demonstrate that modelling between-study variability improves identification and prioritization of MOA-associated genes and provides a robust strategy for integrating heterogeneous functional genomics data in precision oncology.

summary.takeaway: 提出 ConcuRx 统计框架，跨异构 CRISPR 药物反应筛选数据集整合并排序基因，较单数据集与重叠/平均方法更稳定地识别药物 MOA 相关基因。
summary.methods: 建模研究间变异进行跨研究整合与基因优先级排序；应用于 ATR 与 PARP 抑制剂联合用药的 CRISPR 药物反应筛选，并与平均法和重叠法比较。
summary.relevance: 直接关联药物扰动机制主题，并涉及异质功能基因组学数据的整合与证据检索式分析。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告强化 15 个已发表实验验证假设，未给出系统性的定量性能指标；结论主要基于单一药物组合案例，跨药物类别的泛化性未在摘要中体现。

papers.title: Tracing Subliminal Learning Through Pretraining
papers.abstract: Large language models trained on data generated by other models can sometimes inherit traits unrelated to that data, a phenomenon called subliminal learning. We study both hard label distillation, where students train on numbers generated by a biased teacher, and on-policy soft label distillation, where students generate the data and the teacher's logits provide the learning signal. Using Pythia, PolyPythia, and DataDecide OLMo models, we find that transfer persists in both settings across differences in weight initialization, pretraining data order, pretraining corpus, model size, and architecture. Across pretraining checkpoints, the ability to transmit a preference and the ability to acquire one develop separately: some checkpoints are more effective teachers but weaker students, and vice versa. Consistent with this distinction, cross-model transfer can be strongly asymmetric in magnitude when teacher and student roles are reversed. To investigate what carries the preference signal, we construct synthetic number sequences that match the teacher's generated number frequencies but have no dependence on the prompt or preceding numbers and find that these still induce substantial transfer in the hard-label setting. In top-$K$ soft-label distillation, removing animal tokens from the loss reduces transfer, although not completely in the same-model setting. In our experiments, soft label distillation produces more consistent transfer with less extensive training than hard label distillation. The growing use of on-policy distillation in model post-training makes this a particularly relevant setting for assessing unintended preference transfer.

summary.takeaway: 系统研究潜隐学习：学生模型即使只在教师生成的数字上训练，也会继承无关偏好，且该现象跨权重初始化、预训练数据顺序、语料、模型规模与架构持续存在。
summary.methods: 使用 Pythia、PolyPythia 与 DataDecide OLMo 模型，比较硬标签蒸馏与 on-policy 软标签蒸馏；构造与教师数字频率匹配但无提示依赖的合成序列以定位信号载体，并做 top-K 软标签中去除动物 token 的干预。
summary.relevance: 直接关联大语言模型与预训练，对模型后训练中 on-policy 蒸馏的意外偏好传递风险有警示意义。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出效应量的统一量化，也未说明偏好类型与任务范围；机制归因（如 token 频率）为部分证据，不能据此推断所有潜隐特质均按同一路径传递。

papers.title: Compiling Autoregressive LLM Control into Policy-Exact Parallel Inference for Hierarchical RAG
papers.abstract: Large language models increasingly act as controllers in structured decision pipelines, yet their decisions are still executed by autoregressive text decoding. Hierarchical RAG is one such setting: at each frontier of a document tree, an LLM commits to $b$ of $k$ sections under an input-dependent action grammar, executed as either failure-prone free-form JSON or reliable but strictly serial grammar-constrained generation. We show that this serialization is unnecessary for bounded-horizon control: the reachable future forms a shallow action-prefix tree, which we compile --- one root prefill plus one tree-causal probe evaluate every prefix-conditioned action distribution with serial decoding's tokens, positions, and causal ancestry. A prefix-state lemma makes compiled control policy-exact in exact arithmetic: the same policy with a two-forward critical path and zero output tokens. One further probe pass certifies the exact order-marginalized MAP set. Across four document-disjoint splits and two scales on the primary MetaX device, compiled control matches the serial policy on $84$--$89\%$ of questions --- every instrumented divergence a floating-point near-tie --- and cuts control latency by $35$--$47\%$ versus token-wise serial decoding and $6$--$7\%$ versus an idealized chunked engine; an H800 repetition preserves the ordering.

summary.takeaway: 将分层 RAG 中有界视界的 LLM 控制从串行自回归解码编译为并行树探针推理，在保持策略精确性的同时降低控制延迟。
summary.methods: 基于动作前缀树，用一次根 prefill 加一次树因果探针评估所有前缀条件动作分布，并以前缀状态引理保证精确算术下策略一致；另一次探针认证序边缘化 MAP 集；在四个文档不相交划分与两种规模上评测。
summary.relevance: 关联大语言模型与检索增强，针对分层 RAG 控制步骤的推理效率问题。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告 84–89% 问题与串行策略一致，分歧归因于浮点近并列，但该归因来自作者自述；延迟收益在特定设备与引擎对比下测得，通用性需进一步验证。

papers.title: Predicting Music Valence and Arousal via Textual and Multimodal In-Context Learning in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: While arousal can be reliably predicted from musical audio, emotional valence remains difficult to model due to its subjective and context-dependent nature. In this work, we investigate the potential of in-context learning (ICL) with large language models to advance continuous valence and arousal prediction. Rather than predicting emotion scores directly, our framework leverages contextual demonstrations from an auxiliary dataset to refine the initial predictions produced by a small, task-specific base model. We systematically evaluate a text-based ICL variant using lyrics and generated audio captions, alongside a multimodal variant that incorporates raw audio signals. Using the entire MER60 dataset strictly as a held-out test set, our experiments demonstrate substantial performance gains, particularly for valence. Text-based ICL improves the valence $R^2$ from 0.110 to 0.427 with 80 demonstration shots, while the multimodal variant achieves 0.346 with only 10 shots. These findings suggest that training-free ICL offers an effective inference-time strategy for current language models to predict continuous music emotion.

summary.takeaway: 利用大语言模型的上下文学习，以文本或多模态演示精炼小型基模型的音乐效价与唤醒度预测，效价提升尤为明显。
summary.methods: 以辅助数据集提供上下文演示，文本变体使用歌词与生成音频描述，多模态变体加入原始音频；以 MER60 整个数据集作为严格留出测试集，比较不同演示样本数。
summary.relevance: 关联大语言模型与多模态学习，探索免训练 ICL 作为推理时策略用于连续情感预测。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告 R² 数值，未说明与基线差距的统计显著性；依赖生成的音频描述质量，且 MER60 单一测试集上的结论需在其他数据集上验证。

papers.title: SurveyGraph: Generating Academic Surveys via Methods-Entity Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract: Most automated survey generation systems retrieve papers as flat documents, limiting their ability to capture research structure. We present SurveyGraph, a framework built around a Methods-Entity Knowledge Graph (MEKG) encoding method-level follow-on, competition, and shared-resource relations. The graph supports core-paper discovery, retrieval, hybrid outlining, and evidence-gated narrative synthesis. We evaluate retrieval, semantic edges, citation grounding, collection coverage, and generation-stage components. In a controlled seven-method equal-budget benchmark, MEKG-anchored fusion balances recall and structural density, with an independent co-citation check. In a separate archived graph-native diagnostic, graph-aware retrieval nearly doubles recall over flat lexical baselines across eight runs (p = 0.004). A semantic evidence gate achieves AUC = 0.75. Audits of 160 generated sentences find 80.6% anchored-or-partial citation support. Human adjudication of 108 stratified semantic edges finds 68.5% supported-or-partial relations (binary-support Cohen's kappa = 0.64), with improves strongest (80.6%) and extends weakest (52.8%). A SurveyBench-facing collection probe reaches mean reference coverage of 0.521 across four topics with an eight-paper budget. Same-backend Qwen diagnostics on a 30-paper/74-relation graph show reduced organization signals when hybrid outlining is removed. Concurrent-system comparisons provide bounded context rather than matched-backend end-to-end evidence. The results position MEKG as an auditable structural layer for typed diagnostics, relation-specific filtering, and controlled survey generation. Code and artifacts: https://github.com/xzzvsxd/SurveyGraph.

summary.takeaway: 提出 SurveyGraph，以方法-实体知识图谱（MEKG）作为可审计的结构层，支撑核心论文发现、检索、混合式大纲生成与证据门控的综述写作。
summary.methods: 构建编码方法级后续、竞争与共享资源关系的 MEKG；在七方法等预算基准与图原生诊断中评估检索、语义边、引用锚定、覆盖率与生成阶段，并进行人类裁定与共被引检查。
summary.relevance: 直接关联检索增强与知识图谱：用类型化关系图组织检索与生成，并提供证据门控与引用锚定诊断。
summary.caveat: 并发系统对比仅提供有限背景而非同后端端到端证据；语义边支持率与引用支撑率均为部分支持，且 extends 关系最弱；摘要未给出与匹配后端基线的完整端到端比较。

papers.title: Same Luck, Different Choice: Twin-World Credit Assignment for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning rewards a complete episode, yet the policy needs credit for every decision inside it. Counterfactual branching estimates this credit by re-running the episode after an alternative decision, but the branch draws its sampling noise independently of the factual episode, so the outcome difference mixes the effect of the decision with the luck of everything that follows. We observe that in agentic search the retriever, the corpus, and the grader are deterministic, so an episode is a deterministic function of the policy's decisions and its sampling noise. Twin worlds are therefore realizable: the same noise, a different decision. We introduce TWICE (TWIn-world Credit Estimation), which keys the Gumbel noise of every token by turn and line, rolls out counterfactual twins that inherit the factual episode's downstream noise, and turns their paired outcome differences into turn-level advantages for policy-gradient updates on actor-sampled trajectories; only the actor is deployed. Twin credit is unbiased for any coupling quality, its variance is that of an independent counterfactual scaled by $1-ρ$, where $ρ$ is the twins' outcome correlation, and under coupling the number of rollouts needed to resolve an advantage of size $Δ$ falls from $Θ(Δ^{-2})$ to $Θ(Δ^{-1})$. A square-root rule spends the twin budget where outcomes are predicted to disagree per unit cost. On seven question-answering benchmarks, TWICE improves the average exact match of GRPO by 5.3 and 4.5 points on Qwen2.5-3B and 7B, outperforms tree-search and counterfactual-branching baselines, and uses 68% fewer auxiliary tokens than VinePPO.

summary.takeaway: 提出 TWICE，通过共享下游采样噪声的“孪生世界”反事实分支获得回合级信用，降低方差并减少所需 rollout 数。
summary.methods: 按回合与行对 Gumbel 噪声做键控，在由策略决策与噪声决定的确定性智能体搜索环境中生成继承事实噪声的反事实孪生，用配对结果差构造回合级优势供策略梯度更新；在七个问答基准上以 Qwen2.5-3B/7B 评估。
summary.relevance: 关联强化学习与检索增强对齐：面向智能体搜索中的信用分配与采样效率，优于 GRPO、树搜索与反事实分支基线。
summary.caveat: 方法依赖检索器、语料与评分器确定性这一前提；孪生信用虽无偏但方差仍受耦合相关性影响；摘要未报告非确定性环境下的表现。

papers.title: Where Do Long Captions Fail? Position-Aware Diagnosis and Reinforcement Learning for Detailed Image Captioning
papers.abstract: Detailed image captioning is usually framed as an amount problem: a model should mention more visual facts while avoiding hallucination. However, autoregressive VLMs generate captions as ordered sequences, and later generations may be produced under weaker or noisier visual grounding. We therefore argue that long-form captioning should be studied not only by what facts are mentioned, but also by where they appear. We introduce a position-aware rubric representation that decomposes dense human references into atomic visual claims, verifies generated captions against those claims, and induces a quartile-wise composition of supported, hallucinated, and generic content. This lens reveals two qualitatively different failures in long captions: models tend to produce unsupported specificity in the middle, while the final portion often escapes into vague, non-evidential language rather than simply accumulating more hallucination. A same-reference human control does not exhibit these patterns; additional human audits examine the visual validity of the induced labels. Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose PAGER (Position-Aware Grounded Evidence Reinforcement), a GRPO training objective with separate signals for supported fine-grained middle evidence, evidence-bearing tail continuation, claim coverage, and content-aware length control. The result is a closed loop: the same ordered claim representation identifies where long captions fail and supplies the position-specific reward needed to repair those failures. Experiments on detailed-caption benchmarks show that PAGER improves position-wise grounding and pairwise caption preference while preserving competitive global caption quality.

summary.takeaway: 指出长描述失败具有位置性：中部易出现无支撑的具体化，尾部易滑向笼统非证据语言，并提出位置感知的强化学习目标 PAGER 修复。
summary.methods: 将密集人工参考分解为原子视觉断言，按四分位统计支持、幻觉与泛化内容；PAGER 为 GRPO 目标，含中部细粒度证据、尾部证据延续、断言覆盖与内容感知长度控制信号。
summary.relevance: 关联强化学习与对齐：用位置特定的奖励信号改善视觉语言模型的 grounding 与偏好。
summary.caveat: 诊断基于特定参考与人类审计标签，摘要未给出跨模型族或跨数据集的泛化证据；PAGER 仅报告位置 grounding 与成对偏好提升，未给出统一全局指标数值。

papers.title: MOER: Mix-Policy Optimization under Expert Prefix Guidance with Selective Rollback
papers.abstract: Mix-policy optimization incorporates off-policy expert data into the reinforcement learning (RL) loop to transcend the capability boundary of on-policy RL. However, existing methods either provide static full-trace guidance that suppresses self-exploration, or adopt expert prefix guidance without correctness guarantees, leading to suboptimal performance or even training collapse. In this paper, we propose MOER, a mix-policy optimization framework that harmonizes expert guidance with self-exploration. MOER injects a decaying expert chain-of-thought prefix into the prompt and lets the model complete the remaining reasoning, with the prefix length progressively annealed to encourage self-exploration. A selective rollback mechanism replaces failed completions with the original full expert trace, guaranteeing the correctness of every off-policy trajectory. Furthermore, a harmonized mix-policy objective optimizes on-policy tokens with a GRPO loss while supervising both expert prefix and completion tokens with a trust-region SFT loss, substantially stabilizing training. Extensive experiments show that MOER achieves the highest average scores in mathematical and general domain reasoning tasks, outperforming all basic and mix-policy baselines, and generalizes consistently across diverse tasks, model scales, and base model categories. Codes are available at https://github.com/CityU-MLO/MOER.

summary.takeaway: 提出 MOER，将衰减的专家思维链前缀与选择性回滚结合，在保证离策略轨迹正确性的同时保留自探索。
summary.methods: 向提示注入逐步退火的专家 CoT 前缀并由模型补全；失败补全回滚为完整专家轨迹；目标函数以 GRPO 损失优化同策略 token，并以信任域 SFT 损失监督专家前缀与补全 token。
summary.relevance: 关联强化学习与对齐：在混合策略优化中调和专家引导与自探索，并与 GRPO 直接比较。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅给出平均分与相对基线结论，未列具体数值、任务集合规模或与各基线的逐项对比；回滚依赖存在可用的完整专家轨迹。

papers.title: HERD: Harness-Evolving Recursive Distillation for Continual Learning
papers.abstract: Continual learning requires a model to keep acquiring new skills and knowledge without compromising its existing capabilities. Parametric methods suffer from catastrophic forgetting and loss of plasticity. Non-parametric methods, such as prompts, skills, and harnesses, leverage in-context learning but are limited by context length and lossy plain-text compression. To effectively combine their complementary strengths, we propose HERD (Harness-Evolving Recursive Distillation), a hybrid continual learning framework that learns efficiently in the harness and internalizes experience into cumulative capabilities via distillation. On the harness side, HERD continually refines its skills to capture reusable patterns, while retaining high-residual examples that the skills fail to capture in a bounded memory. On the parameter side, HERD performs drift-constrained distillation with dual anchors, substantially reducing forgetting over long recursive runs. On the 25-stage task stream of TRACE+17, under fixed memory and compute budgets, HERD matches the strongest parametric baseline in new-task acquisition while exhibiting the least forgetting and the strongest retention of general capabilities.

summary.takeaway: 提出 HERD，在 harness 侧持续演化技能并保留高残差样例，在参数侧用双锚漂移约束蒸馏，将经验内化为累积能力。
summary.methods: 混合持续学习框架：有界记忆保存技能无法覆盖的高残差示例，参数侧执行带双锚的漂移约束蒸馏；在 TRACE+17 的 25 阶段任务流上于固定记忆与计算预算下评估。
summary.relevance: 关联持续学习与对齐：同时缓解灾难性遗忘与可塑性损失，并与参数化基线比较新任务获取与通用能力保持。
summary.caveat: 证据集中于单一 25 阶段任务流，摘要未报告其他任务流或模型规模下的结果；harness 受上下文长度限制。

papers.title: MVLoMa: Multi-View Local Feature Matching with Any Geometry Foundation Model
papers.abstract: Local feature matching is typically formulated for image pairs, although structure-from-motion and visual localization commonly match one reference image against many retrieved or covisible neighbours. Applying a pairwise matcher independently to these centre-neighbour edges duplicates reference-side computation and prevents the matcher from exploiting complementary multi-view geometric evidence from the remaining observations. To address these limitations, we introduce MVLoMa, a sparse star-graph matcher that extends LoMa from image pairs to multiple views. MVLoMa first uses a frozen multi-view geometry model to jointly describe all images in a star, then injects the resulting cross-view geometric context into local descriptors. It then matches the centre image to all neighbours in a single forward pass through per-view self-attention and bidirectional centre-neighbour cross-attention. For supervision, we derive positive correspondences only from depth-valid, mutually visible dense warps and explicitly penalize high-confidence matches that violate epipolar geometry. On 25-view star graphs from HyperSim, ScanNet++, Mip-NeRF 360, and Tanks and Temples, MVLoMa obtains the best macro-average relative-pose AUC among the compared methods at all three thresholds (58.65/85.41/90.99). Its matcher is 2.20 times faster than sequential evaluation of the 24 centre-neighbour edges. The same design supports four tested frozen geometry encoders -- DA3, $π^3$, VGGT, and VGGT-$Ω$ -- with DA3-Giant performing best on all reported encoder-ablation metrics. Controlled ablations further isolate the effects of geometry-aware descriptors, visibility filtering, geometric negative supervision, and joint multi-view inference.

summary.takeaway: 提出 MVLoMa，将 LoMa 从图像对扩展到星形多视图：用冻结几何基础模型注入跨视图上下文，一次前向完成中心图与全部邻居的匹配。
summary.methods: 以冻结多视图几何模型联合描述星形图内所有图像，注入跨视图几何上下文到局部描述子，经逐视图自注意力与双向中心-邻居交叉注意力匹配；监督仅取深度有效且互相可见的稠密变形正对应，并惩罚违反极几何的高置信匹配。
summary.relevance: 关联预训练与检索增强：复用冻结几何基础编码器（DA3、π³、VGGT、VGGT-Ω）为多视图检索匹配提供结构证据。
summary.caveat: 评估限于 25 视图星形图与四个数据集；依赖冻结几何模型的深度与可见性质量；摘要未报告非星形拓扑或更大规模场景。

papers.title: Random Initialization as a Baseline for Time Series Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) use self-supervised pretraining to learn reusable representations for downstream tasks such as multivariate time series classification (MTSC). We examine how much pretrained weights contribute beyond the architecture itself by comparing seven publicly released instances from four TSFM families with architecture-matched randomly initialized counterparts on the UEA MTSC archive. For each instance, five random initializations are evaluated using four classifiers on frozen representations: ridge classification, logistic regression, RBF SVM, and random forest. After model-specific exclusions due to computational constraints, the study comprises 183 paired dataset-level comparisons. Pretraining improves mean accuracy for all seven instances, but the gains are modest, ranging from 1.43 to 5.19 percentage points, with an overall average improvement of 2.58 points. Three of seven per-instance Wilcoxon signed-rank tests have raw $p$-values below 0.05, but only NuTime remains significant after Holm correction. A secondary pooled test across all 183 pairs gives $p < 0.001$, while the corrected per-instance tests remain the primary evidence. We also compare with ROCKET, Hydra, and Quant, which remain competitive without requiring large-scale pretraining. These findings suggest that MTSC evaluations should distinguish the effect of pretrained weights from that of the underlying architecture and should include both architecture-matched random initialization and strong non-pretrained baselines.

summary.takeaway: 以架构匹配的随机初始化作为时间序列基础模型的基线，发现自监督预训练在 MTSC 上平均仅提升约 2.58 个百分点，且多数单实例检验校正后不显著。
summary.methods: 比较四个 TSFM 家族的七个公开实例与架构匹配随机初始化（每个五次初始化），冻结表示上用岭分类、逻辑回归、RBF SVM 与随机森林评估，共 183 组配对数据集比较，并与 ROCKET、Hydra、Quant 对比。
summary.relevance: 关联预训练：直接检验预训练权重的边际贡献，提示评估需区分预训练与架构效应。
summary.caveat: 提升幅度温和且仅 NuTime 经 Holm 校正后显著，单实例证据有限；受计算约束存在模型特定排除；结论限于 UEA MTSC 分类任务。

papers.title: Constraint Reasoning and Large Language Models Join Forces: Providing Contrastive Explanations for Real-World Optimisation-Based Applications
papers.abstract: We focus on optimisation-based Decision Support Systems in real-world applications. In this context, we aim to provide contrastive explanations that answer users' questions about recommendations based on the solution of an optimisation problem, specifically a Mixed-Integer Program (MIP). Addressing this endeavour is crucial to ensure human oversight of the decisions implemented, as required by international guidelines on trustworthy and responsible automated decision-making systems. We propose a novel methodology that combines constraint reasoning techniques and Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate contrastive explanations for optimisation problems encoded as MIPs. Although LLMs have shown impressive capabilities in Natural Language processing, they can produce incorrect answers due to reasoning limitations. To overcome these limitations, we leverage constraint reasoning techniques to distil the information necessary to produce an explanation, which is then passed as input to an LLM as the so-called graph of reasons. Such a graph captures the semantics and the relationships among constraints of the optimisation problem. Results on real-world scheduling domains show that incorporating constraint reasoning improves explanations generated by the LLM. In particular, using the graph of reasons enables the LLM to produce natural-language explanations that include more relevant reasons while reducing errors compared to explanations generated without this structure.

summary.takeaway: 提出结合约束推理与 LLM 的方法，为 MIP 优化推荐生成对比解释：先由约束推理蒸馏出“理由图”，再交由 LLM 生成自然语言解释。
summary.methods: 对编码为混合整数规划的问题提取约束语义与关系的理由图，作为 LLM 输入生成对比解释；在真实排程域上与无该结构的 LLM 解释进行比较。
summary.relevance: 关联大语言模型与对齐：以结构化约束证据约束 LLM 推理解释，服务于可信自动化决策的人类监督。
summary.caveat: 评估限于真实排程域，摘要未给出量化指标；理由图构建依赖优化问题的显式约束表示，未必适用于隐式约束场景。

papers.title: Rethinking Sequence Compression with Test-time Regression
papers.abstract: Sequence compression is a fundamental operation and a critical information bottleneck in efficient language and multimodal models, and yet prevailing approaches based on pooling or learned projections remain underperforming. We revisit sequence compression through the lens of test-time regression: input tokens define a regression problem whose fitted coefficients form the compressed representation. Importantly, the regression problem is learned end-to-end via backpropagation, while its coefficients are computed efficiently in closed form during the forward pass. This leads to TTR-Compressor, a general alternative to conventional pooling and projection-based compression. We evaluate TTR-Compressor as the compressor for block-wise sparse attention and the visual token merger for multimodal large language models. On block-wise sparse attention, TTR-Compressor improves RULER performance over attention-based compressors by a large margin. For visual token merging, it consistently outperforms the standard MLP merger and matches its performance with 55.6% fewer visual tokens. These results establish test-time regression as an effective primitive for sequence compression in efficient language and multimodal models.

summary.takeaway: 提出将序列压缩视为测试时回归问题，拟合系数作为压缩表示，并在端到端学习中闭式求解，作为池化与投影压缩的通用替代。
summary.methods: 输入 token 定义回归问题，前向传播中高效闭式求系数，回归问题通过反向传播端到端学习；在块稀疏注意力和多模态大模型视觉 token 合并两个场景评估。
summary.relevance: 面向高效大语言模型与多模态学习中的序列压缩与信息瓶颈问题，属于大语言模型与多模态学习交叉方向。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅给出相对提升与 token 减少比例，未披露具体基线、数据集规模和计算开销；所报告结论限于摘要所述两个应用场景。

papers.title: SADRP: A structurally aware multi-modal framework for drug response prediction.
papers.abstract: MOTIVATION: Predicting drug sensitivity across diverse cancer samples is a fundamental challenge in personalized therapy and drug discovery. This task requires comprehensive characterization of both drug and cancer cell line features. Current approaches often fail to fully capture the complex structural characteristics and interactions of drug compounds and struggle to integrate multi-omics features derived from the same sample, limiting their feature representation capacity. Consequently, there is a need for modeling frameworks that can jointly model molecular structural features and multi-modal cellular contexts in a unified manner. RESULTS: We present SADRP, a structurally aware multi-modal framework for drug response prediction, designed to model complex molecular structures and multi-omics data. For drug representation, SADRP incorporates Shortest Distance Path (SDP) encoding and edge encoding to capture both topological relationships and bond-type chemical semantics. For cell line profiling, a multi-view interactive encoder integrates gene expression and DNA methylation, capturing cross-omics synergistic complementarity. SADRP consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, while also identifying potential therapeutic candidates and biomarkers, providing mechanistic insights and supporting applications in drug discovery and personalized medicine.

summary.takeaway: 提出 SADRP 结构感知多模态框架，联合建模药物分子结构与细胞系多组学特征以预测药物响应。
summary.methods: 药物表示采用 Shortest Distance Path 编码与边编码刻画拓扑关系和键型化学语义；细胞系用多视图交互编码器整合基因表达与 DNA 甲基化。
summary.relevance: 与药物扰动机制研究相关，涉及药物敏感性预测和分子结构—细胞多组学联合表示。
summary.caveat: 摘要称持续优于现有方法并识别候选物与生物标志物，但未给出具体数据集、评价指标和数值；属于计算预测，实验验证程度在摘要中不明确。

papers.title: Metagenomic contextualization of proteins with state space models
papers.abstract: Genomic foundation models have emerged as powerful tools for learning representations of biological sequences, but existing approaches predominantly rely on Transformer architectures, whose quadratic attention complexity limits their ability to capture long-range genomic context. This limitation is particularly relevant for metagenomics, where sequencing data have increased more than 500-fold since 2011, generating increasingly large and diverse datasets. For example, gLM2, a Transformer-based mixed-modality genomic language model, was trained with a context window of 4,096 tokens, limiting its ability to capture extended genomic context within metagenomic contigs. Developing scalable architectures capable of processing longer sequences while integrating protein and nucleotide information is therefore essential for advancing genomic foundation models. We introduce Nammu, a 167-million-parameter, bidirectional Mamba-based genomic foundation model that integrates protein and nucleotide sequences within a 20,000-token context window. Leveraging the linear scaling of state-space models, Nammu was trained using a curriculum learning strategy on the OpenMetaGenomic (OMG) corpus, first incorporating 64 million protein sequences followed by 32 million mixed-modality metagenomic contigs. Despite using approximately 37\% fewer training tokens than gLM2, Nammu outperformed this Transformer-based model in taxonomic classification across all evaluated taxonomic ranks on a marine metagenomic dataset from the Critical Assessment of Metagenome Interpretation (CAMI). On the exact-feature-unmatched CAMI II Strain Madness test set, Nammu achieved higher all-contig genus-classification accuracy than Kraken2 (0.9182 versus 0.8142). Nammu further outperformed gLM2 (150M) in KEGG Orthology prediction using deep-sea metagenome-assembled genomes. Together, these results demonstrate the potential of state-space architectures for scalable, multimodal genomic representation learning and highlight their ability to support accurate taxonomic and functional predictions from metagenomic sequences.

summary.takeaway: 提出 167M 参数的双向 Mamba 基因组基础模型 Nammu，在 20,000 token 上下文中整合蛋白与核苷酸序列，实现可扩展宏基因组表征学习。
summary.methods: 基于状态空间模型线性扩展性，在 OpenMetaGenomic 语料上采用课程学习，先训 64M 蛋白序列再训 32M 混合模态宏基因组 contig；在 CAMI 和深海 MAG 上评估分类与 KEGG Orthology 预测。
summary.relevance: 涉及基因组基础模型的预训练与自监督表示学习，以及长上下文宏基因组检索式上下文化。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告在特定 CAMI 数据集上优于 gLM2 与 Kraken2，但训练 token 数、模型规模和任务范围有限；结论不能外推为普遍优于所有 Transformer 模型。

papers.title: Learning Robot Behavior Priors from Non-Robotic Synthetic Data
papers.abstract: Real robot data, rich across tasks and morphologies, is often treated as the bottleneck for training robot learning models, including embodied foundation models that aim for zero-shot physical transfer. In this paper, we investigate the degree to which such models can acquire necessary structure using data from systems without embodiment. To this end, we test if inexpensive, procedurally generated synthetic data can yield useful priors before a model observes any real-world behavior. We study this through robot action prediction, a natural pretraining objective and a direct test of whether structure learned from arbitrary synthetic tasks transfers to embodied settings. We introduce three data generation pipelines that model mathematical abstractions of robotic control, and use them as pretraining priors for a Transformer. We demonstrate that a model trained purely on this non-robotic data attains non-trivial zero-shot prediction performance on unseen physical robot tasks via an in-context learning mechanism, and that our specialized control priors notably improve upon generic causal priors. We also compare against a compute-matched baseline trained on real robot data, and find that it outperforms our model but only on the datasets it was trained on. These findings suggest that procedurally generated, mathematical abstractions can yield useful robotic priors, offering a potential complement to expensive embodied data collection.

summary.takeaway: 探索仅用非具身程序化合成数据预训练 Transformer，可获得迁移到真实机器人任务的零样本行为先验。
summary.methods: 设计三种模拟机器人控制数学抽象的合成数据生成管线作为预训练先验；通过机器人动作预测评估，并与真实机器人数据训练的算力匹配基线比较。
summary.relevance: 与预训练和自监督表示学习相关，关注无具身数据能否为具身基础模型提供可迁移结构。
summary.caveat: 纯合成数据模型仅在零样本场景表现非平凡，真实数据基线在其训练数据集上仍更优；摘要未给出具体任务数量、成功率数值和跨形态泛化证据。

papers.title: Robust identification of cell-cell communication heterogeneity in single cells.
papers.abstract: Cell-cell communication modulates cell fate decisions by relaying information across tissues and inducing intracellular responses mediated by gene regulatory networks. Although the inference of cell-cell communication from high-throughput data is gaining popularity, studying how communication pathways operate across biological scales and influence cell fate decisions remains challenging. Here, we present scRICH (robust identification of cell-cell communication heterogeneity in single cells), a computational framework that leverages single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data to unravel the heterogeneity of communication behavior within cell types, link cell-cell communication to cell fate decisions by incorporating dynamical information on RNA splicing, and connect cell-cell interactions with intracellular responses by constructing multilayer regulatory networks. We validate scRICH with new experiments on epidermal growth factor (EGF) ligand/receptor co-expression in keratinocytes, comparing these predictions against those of existing communication inference methods. Applying scRICH to multiple biological scenarios demonstrates its ability to capture relationships between distinct communication pathways and emerging trends along cell differentiation lineages and in space. A record of this paper's transparent peer review process is included in the supplemental information.

summary.takeaway: 提出 scRICH 计算框架，从单细胞与空间转录组数据识别细胞间通讯异质性，并将其与细胞命运和胞内响应联系起来。
summary.methods: 利用单细胞和空间转录组数据刻画细胞类型内通讯异质性；结合 RNA 剪接动态信息连接通讯与命运决策；构建多层调控网络连接细胞间互作与胞内响应；在角质形成细胞 EGF 配体/受体共表达新实验及多个生物场景中验证。
summary.relevance: 与 GRN/Regulon 及细胞状态调控研究相关，涉及通讯信号—调控网络—命运决策的多尺度整合。
summary.caveat: 摘要以定性描述为主，未给出与现有方法比较的量化指标；预测可靠性依赖数据质量和模型假设，实验验证限于 EGF 共表达场景。

papers.title: DCAF: Unifying Data Validity, Evaluation Validity and Predictive Modeling for Single-cell Perturbation Simulation
papers.abstract: Single-cell perturbation profiling is limited by cost and throughput, while computational methods remain constrained by inconsistent evaluation and underperformance relative to simple baselines. Here we present DCAF, a unified framework for single-cell perturbation simulation that that jointly addresses data validity, evaluation validity and predictive modeling. Among its three components, DCAF-data addresses the single-measurement limitation by reconstructing pre- and post-perturbation status using entropy-regularized optimal transport, and is demonstrated on both cell line and multi-cell type datasets. DCAF-criterion evaluates log fold changes in non-silenced genes to improve sensitivity to model error and robustness to zero inflation noise, validated on synthetic datasets. DCAF-model combines JEPA with explicit modeling for regulatory-dynamics modeling for interpretable prediction. Across benchmarks, DCAF outperforms state-of-the-art deep-learning methods, as well as mean and linear baselines in cross-gene, cross-cell-type and cross-region generalization. In adult Mouse brain, DCAF recapitulates known cell-type-specific regulatory heterogeneity of Dgcr8 knockdown at both cell type and gene levels. DCAF thus provides a rigorous and biologically grounded foundation for reliable perturbation simulation across development, disease and therapeutic discovery.

summary.takeaway: 提出统一框架 DCAF，同时处理单细胞扰动模拟中的数据有效性、评价有效性和预测建模三个问题。
summary.methods: DCAF-data 用熵正则最优传输重建扰动前后状态；DCAF-criterion 基于非沉默基因 log fold change 改进评价敏感性；DCAF-model 结合 JEPA 与显式调控动力学建模；在细胞系和多细胞类型数据及跨基因、跨细胞类型、跨区域泛化基准上评估。
summary.relevance: 直接面向单细胞扰动数据模拟与扰动响应预测，关注评价体系与基线比较问题。
summary.caveat: 摘要称优于 SOTA、均值和线性基线，但未列出具体数据集、指标数值和统计显著性；小鼠脑 Dgcr8 结果属于已知调控异质性的重现，非独立实验验证。

papers.title: PETRO enables robust estimation of on-target perturbation effects in Perturb-seq
papers.abstract: Perturb-seq uses multiple guides per target as replicates, but off-target effects can bias target-level estimates even with efficient target perturbation. We present PETRO, which recovers the on-target perturbation effect while allowing, for each outcome, an unknown minority of guides to have arbitrary off-target effects. Across CRISPRa and CRISPRi datasets, sequence-associated off-target bias persisted after pooling cells across guides and nearly doubled in one CRISPRa dataset after a published guide filter. PETRO largely removed this bias and reduced transmission of effects from independently flagged promiscuous guides. In simulations, PETRO nearly matched pooling in power without off-target effects; with off-target effects, pooling remained biased as cell numbers increased, whereas PETRO recovered the on-target perturbation effect. In cortical Perturb-seq, most ZNF219 pathway enrichments from pooling rested on one guide and did not survive majority-supported aggregation, unlike those for targets with concordant guides. PETRO enables robust target-level Perturb-seq analysis from replicate-guide agreement.

summary.takeaway: 提出 PETRO，在允许每条 guide 存在任意脱靶效应的前提下，从多 guide 重复中稳健估计 Perturb-seq 的 on-target 扰动效应。
summary.methods: 对每个结局假定未知少数 guide 具有任意脱靶效应，通过 guide 间复制一致性恢复 on-target 效应；在 CRISPRa/CRISPRi 数据集和模拟中评估，并应用于皮层 Perturb-seq。
summary.relevance: 与单细胞扰动实验的效应估计和脱靶偏倚校正直接相关，影响扰动筛选结论的可靠性。
summary.caveat: 方法依赖“少数 guide 脱靶”的假设，若脱靶 guide 比例较高可能失效；摘要未报告效应估计偏差的具体数值和适用范围边界。

papers.title: Reinforcement learning with evolutionary priors unlocks multi-site enzyme optimization from sparse experimental feedback
papers.abstract: Industrial enzymes underpin sustainable manufacturing, yet natural proteins rarely combine the activity, robustness and application compatibility required for practical use. Engineering such properties requires identifying beneficial combinations of interacting mutations within vast sequence spaces that are too large to search exhaustively and too sparsely sampled to model reliably. Here we introduce AlphaVariant, a reinforcement-learning (RL) framework that couples a generative evolutionary prior with iteratively updated low-N fitness models to enable feedback-driven search of large combinatorial protein sequence spaces. Across six experimentally measured protein fitness landscapes, AlphaVariant ranked first on the three large, non-enumerable multi-site landscapes. In two successive rounds of savinase activity optimization, AlphaVariant-designed libraries yielded 75.4% and 83.8% activity-improved variants among experimentally characterized candidates even as the accessible mutation space expanded from 25 to 67 positions. The search identified beneficial mutation combinations involving up to 17 structurally dispersed sites and produced a variant with 7.1-fold higher activity than wild type after only two design-test cycles. We then extended AlphaVariant to jointly optimize activity, thermostability and a patent-informed constraint for intellectual-property freedom. This multi-objective search yielded variants that outperformed the commercial protease Uno 100 L in both biochemical assays and application-relevant detergent washing tests. These results demonstrate that generative RL can efficiently navigate vast protein fitness landscapes, progressively incorporate multiple engineering objectives and convert sparse experimental feedback into enzyme variants with industrially relevant performance, effectively resolving the limits of biocatalyst engineering.

summary.takeaway: 提出 AlphaVariant 强化学习框架，结合生成式进化先验与迭代低样本适应度模型，从稀疏实验反馈中优化多位点酶。
summary.methods: 将生成式进化先验与迭代更新的低 N 适应度模型耦合，进行反馈驱动搜索；在六个实验测量的蛋白适应度景观上评估，并用于 savinase 活性优化及活性、热稳定性和专利约束的多目标优化。
summary.relevance: 属于强化学习在蛋白工程中的应用，涉及稀疏反馈下的序列组合搜索与多目标优化。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告的具体提升倍数和通过率来自其自有实验流程，未说明与哪些优化方法全面比较；多目标结果基于专利信息约束，外推到其他酶或约束条件需谨慎。

papers.title: Discrete synaptic states and context-modulated readouts support continual learning
papers.abstract: Biological neural systems learn new behaviors while retaining earlier ones, whereas sequentially trained artificial networks often overwrite parameters and forget previously learned behaviors. We introduce the Context-modulated Synaptic-states Recurrent Neural Network (CoSyn-RNN), a new continual-learning model inspired by heterogeneous synaptic states and neuromodulatory control. CoSyn-RNN combines sparse recurrent allocation with a discrete protection rule: after each task, recurrent neurons whose synaptic weights cross a fixed threshold form a task-specific neuron group, and their associated parameters enter a protected state during later learning. A neuron-specific gain and a task-cued mask over a fixed base readout control how recurrent activity contributes to behavior. Across various task sequences consisting of many cognitive tasks, training and validation losses and accuracies were maintained throughout learning. The protection rule produced modular, task-ordered recurrent structure compatible with forward reuse of earlier computations. Pairwise recruitment measurements further defined minimum- and maximum-cost curricula that produced markedly different final recurrent structures and different remaining capacity for future learning. Thus, CoSyn-RNN provides a biologically inspired model in which protected synaptic states, sparse allocation, and context-dependent modulation support continual learning.

summary.takeaway: 提出 CoSyn-RNN，用离散的突触保护状态与情境调制读出，在连续学习任务序列中维持训练和验证表现并形成模块化的任务有序循环结构。
summary.methods: 构建稀疏循环分配加固定阈值保护规则的循环神经网络；任务后权重越过阈值的神经元形成任务特异群组并在后续学习中受保护；用神经元特异的增益和任务提示掩码控制固定基础读出的贡献；在多任务序列上评估，并比较成对招募成本构成的最小/最大成本课程。
summary.relevance: 直接针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘，提出受生物突触异质性和神经调质控制启发的模型，属于持续学习主题。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告损失和准确率得以维持，未给出具体数值、对照基线或遗忘量指标；任务序列类型和规模也未详述，保护规则的可扩展性需原文验证。
